gaps.sentence: He behaves as if he were ___ owner of the company.
gaps.explanation: 'The owner' — there is one owner, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: ___ Lake Constance lies between Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
gaps.explanation: Lakes take no article when 'Lake' comes first.

gaps.sentence: ___ few days he had left were spent packing.

gaps.explanation: 'Inflation' as a general economic concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
___ books you left on my desk were really useful.
gaps.explanation: 'The books you left…' — the clause identifies which books.

gaps.sentence: ___ piano was invented in Italy in the early eighteenth century.
gaps.explanation: 'The + singular instrument' refers to the whole class: the piano.

gaps.sentence: She was elected ___ president of the students' union.
gaps.explanation: After 'elect/appoint/make + role', the article is usually dropped: elected president.
